== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Kashyyyk (Japanese)|Kashyyyk]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67693 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(15, 2, 471, 633)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e8d0629fb7b94e7131aa10a217b8045724d00fcbdcd762f0d540fea0b3a102a4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/22/Japanese-ANH-Kashyyyk-SWCA-67693.jpg Internet Archive item].
